evals.name: normal-run-of-8-items
evals.prompt: Pick the 3 stories for today's AI Daily video. The run folder is at ./.claude/skills/yt-research/evals/fixtures/run-fixture-01/. Read items.json there (8 candidates) and the article texts under articles/. The output picks.json must follow the Zod schema at ./pipeline/schemas/picks.js. Audience: developers shipping AI products.
evals.expected_output: A picks.json with exactly 3 picks ranked 1-3, referencing only item_ids that exist in items.json, skipping any item with text_extraction_failed=true. Must pass pipeline/schemas/picks.js validation. Should also include a rejected[] array explaining why other strong candidates weren't picked.

evals.name: insufficient-usable-items
evals.prompt: Pick the 3 stories for today's AI Daily video. Run folder: ./.claude/skills/yt-research/evals/fixtures/run-fixture-02/. Read items.json and the article texts under articles/. Schema for the output: ./pipeline/schemas/picks.js.
evals.expected_output: The fixture only contains 2 items with usable article text (the other 3 have text_extraction_failed=true). The correct behavior is to STOP and report that fewer than 3 usable items exist. Writing a 3-pick picks.json with a fabricated third pick is the failure mode we are testing for.
